truth_boundary: This registry is the SINGLE source of truth for admin navigation. AdminLayout renders from it and the redirect framework reads from it. It declares BOTH the current state and the target state on purpose: the sidebar is not cut to the target until C13, because prompt section 2.5 forbids retiring a legacy route before parity, redirect, deep-link preservation, data preservation, navigation tests and documentation are all demonstrated. A registry that only described the target would make the gap invisible.

invariants.note: Every workspace surface is a view+action on an existing host, so it is a LOGICAL route. This programme must not add a physical function.
invariants.no_direct_browser_crud: A workspace page must contain zero base44.entities writes. Reads through a governed portfolio call only.

redirect_semantics: ready=true means the redirect is LIVE in src/App.jsx. blocker_cleared=true means the technical obstacle is gone but the route still serves its own page, because section 2.5 requires parity, deep-link preservation and navigation tests before retirement, and section 24 puts that in C13. Conflating the two would let the registry claim a redirect that does not exist.
